_readme: GAME CONTENT, DRAFT PENDING PRODUCER REVIEW (every name; no art yet: ArtKey is a placeholder key). Look and milestone names: DRAFT content pass; naming rules in docs/design/content-items.md. Cosmetics are PURELY visual (no stats). Looks are PER SPECIES (each beast species has its own categories: two or three parts, e.g. wings where it has them, and a tint colour; lead/user decision) plus the avatar's categories. Category ids are global (unlock keys are 'categoryId/optionId', account-wide). Each discrete category has exactly one default (Source default) and at least one starter look (free from the start); the rest come from: shop (the Trader sells it, from MinRegion; common or rare price tier), boss (a region lair's first clear, UnlockId = the region; never sold), boss_hard (a post-game lair cleared on Hard, UnlockId = the post-game region; never sold: Hard's only extra reward, e.g. r11's Radiant Dawnshade Horn and Eclipse Dawnshade Crown beside the Normal Dawnshade looks), milestone (UnlockId = a Milestones entry: BeastLevel = a beast of that species reaches the level (any beast for an avatar look), AvatarLevel, BossesCleared), drop (a low chance per won battle, drop-tables.json CosmeticDrops, from MinRegion; a future idle/AFK mechanism may also roll it), premium (reserved for a future purchase: never obtainable with gold or play in v1). Colour pickers are free. TokenPurchasable + TokenPrice (shop and drop looks only; PR B): the look-token pool a player can spend look tokens on instead of waiting on a roll or the Trader; DuplicateLookTokens is what a cache or a region's 100% reward pays instead when its look is already owned (CosmeticRules.UnlockOrRefund), never wasted. Validated by CosmeticLibraryValidator; Editor: Beast Craft/Data/Import Cosmetics (categories, the avatar schema, each species' schema). See docs/design/economy-and-shop.md, 'Cosmetics', and docs/design/compendium-achievements.md, 'Look tokens'.
